title: NativeScript vs Expo — wrapper-allowed condition
notes: Secondary condition (PLAN-EXPO §5): identical to ns-vs-expo minus the no-capability-wrapper rule, so third-party HealthKit/Speech wrappers are permitted. A separate slug — not a flag on the primary study — so its trials can never be folded into the primary medians by accident. Its spec dir is created only when this condition is run.
